svg.aria-label: Day 3 hero: Sample essay 4.1 is taken apart into coloured strips — background, BUT issue, SO position, counter-argument, reason 1 and reason 2 — while a student cheers and a big magnifying glass looks closer. A balance weighs green achievements against heavier red problems. Around it: a rainforest, an eco-lodge, palms, a sea turtle and coral reef, and on the right a seminar presenter with a “Green jobs” slide.
